Добавьте песню и подготовьте её к исполн: Add a song and prepare it for singing.
Пойте, настройте звук и сохраните исполн: Sing, adjust your sound and save your performance.
Что хотите сделать?: What would you like to do?
Например: не слышу себя или как записать: For example: I cannot hear myself or how to record a song
Попробуйте написать короче: «микрофон»,: Try a shorter phrase: “microphone”, “delay”, “record”, or choose a section.
Пример экрана приложения. Нужный элемент: An example app screen. The relevant control is highlighted.
The main steps are described above the video.
Подготовьте приложение к первой песне: Get the app ready for your first song
В пустой библиотеке откройте «Настроить: In the empty library, open “Configure audio” and check your microphone and headphones. With local processing selected, the model download button appears when required models are missing. To come back to the guide, use the information button in the library.
Панель над карточками позволяет выбрать: The bar above the cards lets you select all shown songs or delete the selection. You can delete other songs from your library while a song is processing. Songs that are queued or processing and songs shared by other room participants cannot be deleted.
В настройках обработки нажмите «Экспорт: In the processing settings, click “Export library”. The app creates a ZIP and shows it in File Explorer. Copy it to another drive or to a folder outside the app's data.
На том же экране нажмите «Импорт библиот: On the same screen, click “Import library” and select the ZIP. The app adds missing songs and skips songs already in the library. It shows both counts when finished.
Перетащите консоль за свободное место: Grab an empty part of the console
Возьмите консоль за свободную часть и ве: Grab a clear part of the console and drag it toward the window edge. The arrows on the frame dock the console to an edge. In a separate window, “Return to the app” brings it back to Karaoke.
Click an empty part of the melody roll. Drag the panel by its surface. To resize it, drag one of the handles that appears along its edges.
Возьмите свободную область блока и перет: Grab a clear part of the room panel and drag it within the app or past the window edge. Drag the detached panel back or click “Return to the app”.
Подключите второй дисплей и откройте пес: Connect a second display and open a song. Click “On TV” on the console. The switch is available when two displays are connected and you are outside an online room.
Пока караоке на втором экране, откройте: While Karaoke is on the second screen, open another ready song in the library. “Play next” queues it. “Play now” finishes the current performance and starts the selected song.
Верните караоке в основное окно: Bring Karaoke back to the main window
Нажмите «Вернуть на ноутбук» на пульте в: Click “Back to the laptop” on the remote in the library or press Escape in the Karaoke window. The remote can also pause the song or end the performance.
В библиотеке нажмите «Друзья». Здесь мож: Click “Friends” in the library. You can invite a friend to an open room or create a room together with a friend who is online. Incoming requests are in the “Requests” tab.
Ведущий может включить «Совместное управ: The host can turn on shared controls to let participants select songs and control playback. To change the host, open a participant's menu in the room panel.
При сбое в блоке комнаты можно повторить: If the transfer fails, retry it from the room panel. If the app reports a different version on your computer, decide whether you need your own copy before confirming replacement with the host's version.
Дождитесь восстановления связи: Wait for the room to reconnect
При кратком обрыве приложение само пытае: After a brief disconnect, the app tries to reconnect automatically. Check your internet connection and wait for the reconnecting message to clear. If it does not reconnect and the room is still open, join again using the invitation.
Выберите драйвер «Windows» и подключите: Select the “Windows” driver and connect wired headphones. Turn on monitoring and adjust the microphone level.
В обычном режиме Windows делит устройств: In Shared mode, Windows shares the device with other apps. When you enable monitoring or join a room, the app requests Exclusive mode and picks a buffer. It returns to Shared when monitoring is off and no room is active. ASIO is selected separately.
В разделе расчётной задержки откройте по: Open the latency details in Audio settings and click “Measure” or “Check with signals”. Measure before starting a song and follow the hint next to the button.
Если буфер доступен для настройки, увели: If the buffer can be adjusted, increase it and check the sound again. ASIO settings may be available in the driver's control panel. Windows Exclusive chooses its buffer automatically.
Если появилось предупреждение «AudioServ: If “AudioService is unavailable” appears, wait for recovery. The app tries to restore the position and resume interrupted playback. In a room, watch the connection status and shared song.
После восстановления проверьте, что слыш: After recovery, check that the song is audible and enable monitoring if you need it. Once you finish, open the song's recordings and listen to the saved performance. An outage can leave separate fragments.
Сохраните диагностику, если звук не верн: Save diagnostics if the sound does not return
Проверьте вход и выход в «Аудио». Если п: Check the input and output in Audio settings. If the warning stays or comes back, save the report from Advanced settings and note what you were doing before the interruption.
Regular fields save automatically. After entering a value, wait for the status next to the field to update. Do not share screenshots that reveal secret keys.
В карточке Kaggle нажмите «Войти в Kaggl: In the Kaggle card, click “Sign in to Kaggle”, then “Deploy and start”. Wait for it to start and check the status. Then select Kaggle in the processing settings.
Прослушивание и сохранение записи: Listening to and saving a recording
Что удаляется вместе с песней: What is deleted with a song
Почему оценка задержки неполная: Why the latency estimate is incomplete
Нажмите «Добавить песню» в библиотеке ил: Click Add song in the library or drag an audio file into the window.
Выберите один или несколько аудиофайлов: Choose one or more audio files
Подтвердите выбор в системном окне. Песн: Confirm your choice in the file dialog. Songs are added and queued for processing immediately. Check the title, artist and language in the song settings.
Начните вводить название или исполнителя: Start typing a title or artist in the library search field.
Сузьте список и выберите порядок: Filter the list and choose its order
Кнопка справа в строке поиска открывает: The button on the right of the search field opens filters and sorting. Clear the search and filters to see the entire library again.
В настройках обработки выберите этот ком: In processing settings, choose this computer or Kaggle. For local processing, wait until all models are ready.
Новая песня отправляется на обработку ав: A new song is queued for processing automatically. Click “Ready for karaoke” next to “Friends” to open the queue and see progress or error details.
Готовую песню можно открыть в караоке. Д: A ready song can be opened in karaoke. For a remix or live recording, review the recognized lyrics before singing.
В настройках готовой песни выберите «Ред: In the settings of a ready song, choose Melody editor. Listen to the section you want to correct.
Compare the words, timing and notes with the vocal. Edit a short section and listen again. Save writes a new project revision.
Повторная обработка или сброс текста мог: Processing again or resetting lyrics may replace manual edits. Read the confirmation first and export any library you need to keep.
Отметьте чекбокс на карточке: Select a checkbox on a song card
Нажмите чекбокс в правом верхнем углу пе: Click the checkbox in the top right corner of a song. Selection turns on so you can select other cards. Cancel clears the selection.
Панель над карточками позволяет выбрать: The toolbar above the cards lets you select all displayed songs or delete selected songs. Search and filters apply. Songs being processed and other participants’ songs cannot be deleted.
Удаляются её проекты и записи исполнения: Its projects and performance recordings are deleted too. This cannot be undone. Export the library first to keep any data you need.
Нажмите кнопку с наушниками на карточке: Click the headphones button on the song card. This is where the song’s saved performances are listed.
У записи доступны прослушивание, переиме: You can listen, rename, open the file’s folder or delete a recording. An analysis error does not mean the audio is lost: try playing it first.
На том же экране выберите «Импорт библио: On the same screen, choose Import library and select the archive. Existing songs are kept. Wait for the import to finish.
На карточке со статусом «Готово» нажмите: Click play on a card marked Ready. Karaoke opens and the performance starts.
Заранее выберите вход и выход в настройк: Choose your input and output in audio settings beforehand. To try singing without saving, use Rehearsal without recording on the song card.
Нажмите паузу на консоли или пробел. Пов: Press pause on the console or the space bar. Press again to resume. While typing, keys belong to the text field.
Стрелки влево и вправо перематывают на 5: Left and right arrows seek by 5 seconds, or 15 with Shift. Home returns to the beginning. Stop finishes the performance.
M — мониторинг микрофона, N — ноты, T —: M: microphone monitoring; N: notes; T: lyrics; [ and ]: key; − and +: tempo; Escape: exit; F11: full screen. Room controls depend on participant permissions.
Настройте баланс голоса и музыки: Balance your voice and the music
На консоли отдельно регулируются музыка,: The console has separate music, voice and master levels. Enable monitoring to hear your own microphone.
Используйте эффекты и пресеты консоли. П: Use the console’s effects and presets. Listen through headphones. If you hear a doubled voice, check whether monitoring is also enabled on your audio interface.
Выберите, что показывать на сцене: Choose what to show on stage
На консоли включите или скройте текст и: Show or hide lyrics and notes on the console. These switches are independent; the shortcuts are T and N.
Выделите панель нот, чтобы изменить разм: Select the notes panel to resize or move it. The console placement menu lets you dock to an edge or use free placement.
Откройте подготовленную песню обычной кн: Open a prepared song with the regular play button. When a microphone is available, recording starts with the performance. You do not need to enable it separately.
Пойте, затем нажмите остановку или верни: Sing, then press stop or return to the library and wait for saving to finish. Rehearsal without recording does not save a performance.
В библиотеке нажмите наушники на карточк: In the library, click the headphones on the same song’s card. Choose a performance to listen to.
Откройте записи через кнопку с наушникам: Open recordings with the headphones button on the song card. Press play on the performance you want.
Кнопка папки у исполнения показывает его: The folder button reveals the recording file in Explorer. Copy the recording to your chosen folder. To preserve the entire library, export an archive.
Откройте записи песни и нажмите анализ у: Open the song’s recordings and choose analysis for a performance. Wait for the result; the task can run in the background.
Откройте «Онлайн-комната» из библиотеки: Open Online room from the library and enter your name. Other participants will see it.
Настройте фото и имя профиля: Set your profile photo and name
Параметры профиля находятся во вкладке «: Profile settings are in Appearance. Joining a room requires internet and access to the room server.
Нажмите «Онлайн-комната» в библиотеке. П: Click Online room in the library. Check your name.
Нажмите «Создать комнату» и дождитесь по: Click Create room and wait for the connection. You can then invite participants.
Откройте «Онлайн-комната», укажите имя и: Open Online room, enter your name and paste the code you received from another participant.
Нажмите кнопку присоединения. Если вы от: Click Join. If you opened an invitation link, check the prefilled code and confirm joining.
В открытой комнате найдите код или ссылк: In the open room, find its code or invitation link. Send it to the person you want to sing with.
Дождитесь появления участника: Wait for the participant to join
Друг открывает приглашение или вводит ко: Your friend opens the invitation or enters its code in Online room. Make sure they have joined before starting.
Откройте готовую песню из библиотеки ком: Open a ready song from the room library. Choosing and starting songs depends on participant permissions.
Дождитесь загрузки у всех: Wait for everyone to finish loading
Дождитесь передачи проекта и готовности: Wait for the project transfer and participant readiness. Do not start while participants are still downloading the song.
Настройте вход, выход и наушники до совм: Set up the input, output and headphones before singing together. Listen to your own voice through local monitoring.
Запускайте, ставьте на паузу и перематыв: Start, pause and seek with the room controls. Other voices arrive through the server; connection quality affects how well you hear them.
Вернитесь к управлению комнатой и выбери: Return to the room controls and choose Leave. If a performance is in progress, finish it first using an available control.
При обрыве проверьте интернет и состояни: If disconnected, check your internet and server status, then reopen the invitation or enter the room code.
Во вкладке «Внешний вид» выберите тему,: In Appearance, choose your theme, language and interface settings.
Настройте шрифты и анимацию под свой экр: Adjust fonts and animation for your screen. Profile and appearance options are here too.
Откройте «Аудио» и выберите устройства в: Open Audio and choose the input and output devices. Check your cables and system volume levels.
Начните с Windows Shared и проводных нау: Start with Windows Shared and wired headphones. Enable monitoring and choose a comfortable microphone level.
Shared работает совместно с другими прил: Shared works alongside other applications. Exclusive and ASIO require device support. A smaller buffer reduces latency but may cause dropouts. Change one setting at a time and check the sound.
В «Аудио» выберите именно подключённый м: In Audio, select the microphone you connected. Check its cable, Windows level and microphone permission for desktop applications.
Включите прослушивание своего голоса: Enable monitoring of your own voice
Включите мониторинг и поднимите уровень: Enable monitoring and raise the microphone level. Check the output device too. If monitoring is off, you may not hear your own voice in headphones.
Проверьте устройства и режим: Check the devices and audio mode
Используйте проводные наушники. В «Аудио: Use wired headphones. In Audio, check the selected driver and estimated latency.
Если устройство поддерживает ASIO, выбер: If your device supports ASIO, select it and check the sound. Reduce the buffer gradually; if dropouts occur, return to a larger value.
Показатель программы не всегда включает: The app’s estimate may not include all device and wireless latency. If your voice is doubled, avoid using hardware and software monitoring at the same time.
Закройте тяжёлые приложения и проверьте: Close demanding applications and check the sound without processing a song at the same time. Check the cable and selected devices.
В настройках выбранного драйвера увеличь: Increase the selected driver’s buffer and try singing again. ASIO settings may be in the driver’s own control panel.
В настройках обработки выберите локальны: In processing settings, choose the local computer or Kaggle. Kaggle runs remotely and requires access settings.
Для локальной обработки нужны все обязат: Local processing requires all mandatory models. Click Download for any missing model and wait for Ready, including file verification.
Whisper распознаёт слова, Demucs разделя: Whisper recognizes words, Demucs separates audio, and MMS aligns words to time. Removing a model frees disk space and keeps songs and recordings. You will need to download it again for future local processing.
Проверьте способ обработки и модели: Check the processing method and models
Для локальной обработки дождитесь готовн: For local processing, wait until all models are ready. For Kaggle, check access settings and the remote worker.
Посмотрите точную причину в очереди: Find the exact error in the queue
Откройте очередь обработки и подробности: Open the processing queue and the failed task’s details. Check disk space and memory. Save the exact error text for diagnosis.
Закройте тяжёлые приложения и повторите: Close demanding applications and retry after freeing memory. Cancel unwanted tasks in the app; do not delete their working files manually.
Во вкладке «Ключи ENV» найдите нужный се: In ENV keys, find the service you need. Enter values using the field labels and hints.
Сохраните изменения доступной кнопкой, з: Save using the available button, then return to the processing method you are configuring. Do not share screenshots with secret values revealed.
Во вкладке «Дополнительно» находятся вер: Advanced contains the app version, diagnostics, history and disk usage information.
Перед переустановкой или удалением нужны: Before reinstalling or removing data you need, export the library to a separate folder. When asking for help, include the version and steps to reproduce.
Откройте настройки обработки и нажмите «: Open processing settings and click Export library. Keep the archive outside the installation and app data folders.
В окне анализа нажмите «Создать Studio M: In the analysis window, click Create Studio Master and wait for processing to finish. The original recording is kept.
Откройте записи песни и переключайтесь м: Open the song’s recordings and switch between the processed version and the original on the performance card.
Выберите раздел или опишите задачу своим: Choose a section or describe your task in your own words.
